title: SIDESTORY: THE GREAT CHIEF RETURNS OPEN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: THE GREAT CHIEF RETURNS OPEN
DETAILS: The Great Chief Returns event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from event shop.
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete missions in the Brave’s Trials by clearing event stages. Completing specific mission can obtain event special furniture Warchief’s Throne as reward.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Tomimi, Tribal Inn Furniture (Pieces), Mechanical Parts.
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Mechanical Parts by clearing event stages and the Brave’s Trials. Mechanical Parts can be used to redeem items from Inam Committee.
MAIN REWARDS: Tomimi's Token, Tribal Inn Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, LMD, Battle Record, Elite Materials, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Public Affairs. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Public Affairs.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – HEART OF STEEL THE RAGE IRONHIDE
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Heart of Steel The Rage Ironhide", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
DETAILS: The following Operators will appear at Headhunting “Heart of Steel The Rage Ironhide”, and will be permanently added to other Headhunting in future update.
Operator Tomimi is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event The Great Chief Returns. Operator Tomimi is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
Eunectes, Flint, Tomimi, and Aciddrop will gain more trust within this event.
04 CORAL COAST COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Coral Coast Collection – Seeker SKm01 for SilverAsh
Coral Coast Collection - Summer Flowers FA333 for Ceobe
Coral Coast Collection – Seeker SK03 for Croissant
05 CORAL COAST COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Coral Coast Collection – Casual Vacation HD01 for Vigna
Coral Coast Collection - Sunburn SS.SP for Ifrit
Coral Coast Collection - Summer Flowers FA361 for Sora
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Tribal Inn, will be available during the event.
The Great Chief Returns event rewards and redeem in Inam Committee (Pieces)
The furniture pieces of this furniture set will be available at the Store from February 25, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – March 11, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: The brand new mode Integrated Strategies will be open during the event. Players can obtain Delicious Honey Biscuit by completing adventures in Ceobe's Fungimist. When Biscuits reach a certain number, players can obtain corresponding rewards in Honey Biscuit Castle.
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 3-8 and The Great Chief Returns Event Stage RI-1
DETAILS: All Squads and Collections in Integrated Strategies will be unlocked for players to experience during this period.
After March 18, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7), the Integrated Strategies ends, the unfinished adventure will be forced to end, and you cannot obtain rewards from this adventure.
For more details about the Integrated Strategies mode. Please pay attention to related update notices.
Players can obtain Delicious Honey Biscuit through adventures. When Biscuits reach a certain number, players can obtain corresponding rewards in Honey Biscuit Castle.
MAIN REWARDS: Coral Coast Collection - Summer Flowers FA661 for Utage, LMD, Battle Record, Shop Voucher, Elite Materials, etc.
DETAILS: For celebrating 10 million downloads (CN Server not included), players will receive one Ten-roll Headhunting Permit as a gift.
REQUIREMENT: All the players who logged in and created a character before February 25, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7), including guest accounts.
